name: 3:2:1 Crack Spread Mean Reversion
description: Mean reversion strategy on the 3:2:1 crack spread (2×RB + 1×HO − 3×CL). Uses cross-sectional aggregation to compute the spread from each asset's own continuation-adjusted prices, avoiding reference_futures alignment errors. Enters long the crack spread when the 20-day rolling z-score drops below -1.5, exits when z-score crosses back above 0. Trade legs: Long 2 RB + Long 1 HO + Short 3 CL per spread unit.
source:
# 3:2:1 Crack Spread Mean Reversion Strategy
# Spread = (2 × RB_barrel + 1 × HO_barrel - 3 × CL) / 3
# RB and HO priced in $/gallon → multiply by 42 for $/barrel
# Entry: Z-score < -1.5 (spread compressed), Exit: Z-score > 0 (mean reversion)
# Legs: Long 2 RB, Long 1 HO, Short 3 CL per spread unit
#
# Architecture: Each asset uses its own continuation series. The crack spread
# is computed via cross-sectional sum of weighted contributions, ensuring
# date-aligned prices without reference_futures alignment issues.

# --- Primary market data with continuation adjustment ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# --- Asset Identification ---
is_cl = is_asset_ref(ticker="CL")()
is_rb = is_asset_ref(ticker="RB")()
is_ho = is_asset_ref(ticker="HO")()

# --- Weighted price contribution per asset for the crack spread ---
# Crack spread = (2 × RB_barrel + 1 × HO_barrel - 3 × CL) / 3
# RB contribution: +2 × close × 42 / 3  (long 2 barrels of gasoline)
# HO contribution: +1 × close × 42 / 3  (long 1 barrel of heating oil)
# CL contribution: -3 × close / 3 = -close  (short 3 barrels of crude)
weighted_price = conditional_select(
    is_rb, 2 * close * 42 / 3,
    is_ho, 1 * close * 42 / 3,
    is_cl, -1 * close,
    0
)

# --- Cross-sectional sum produces the crack spread on every pipeline ---
crack_spread = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(weighted_price)

# --- Rolling Z-Score of the Crack Spread (20-day window) ---
z = zscore(window=20)(crack_spread)

# --- Entry / Exit Signals ---
# Enter long spread when z < -1.5 (spread unusually compressed)
# Exit when z crosses back above 0 (mean reversion complete)
entry_trigger = z < -1.5
exit_trigger = z > 0

# Persistent state: True from entry until exit
in_spread = hold_until()(enter=entry_trigger, exit=exit_trigger)

# --- Entry/Exit Pulses for Zone Management ---
entry_pulse = crossunder(z, -1.5)
exit_pulse = crossover(z, 0)

# Route entry directions per asset:
# RB, HO → long entry (buy the products)
# CL → short entry (sell crude)
# Exit: opposing entry closes the zone
long_entry_sig = ((is_rb or is_ho) and entry_pulse) or (is_cl and exit_pulse)
short_entry_sig = (is_cl and entry_pulse) or ((is_rb or is_ho) and exit_pulse)

# --- Execution ---
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_entry_sig, short_entry=short_entry_sig)

# Position sizing: 3:2:1 ratio in contract units
# Only size when actively in the spread; 0 skips sizing for unwanted opposing zones
unit_size = conditional_select(
    in_spread and is_cl, 3,
    in_spread and is_rb, 2,
    in_spread and is_ho, 1,
    0
)
position_size(type=SizeType.unit)(size=unit_size)
